correctness.rationale: Face-traced every oriented dart in the explicit K4,5 rotation to seven 4-faces and two 6-faces; V=9, E=20, F=9 yields genus 2. The prescribed two-vertex operation inserts x,y before/after a distinguished b0 at alternating a-vertices and gives two consistent x,y rotations, causing four new quad faces while preserving the two 6-faces. Independently implemented face permutation on every extension for odd n=5 through 31, each exactly 2n-3 quadrilaterals and two hexagons. The local boundary switching is verified as a fixed rotation pattern, and Euler gives genus increase 1; Ringel lower bound ceil((4-2)(n-2)/4) gives (n-1)/2 for odd n. Finite tracing corroborates but cannot by itself prove arbitrary n; the local induction supplies that step.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks corroborate the proven ranges but do not substitute for all-parameter argument.
